items.headline: World Cup 2026 Kicks Off Across North America
items.body: The FIFA World Cup 2026 has commenced, marking the first edition of the tournament to feature an expanded 48-team format across three host countries: Canada, Mexico, and the United States. A total of 104 matches will be played across 16 host cities, including major venues like MetLife Stadium in New Jersey and SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.

items.headline: Brazil's Pre-Tournament Form and Key Players
items.body: Brazil, under coach Carlo Ancelotti, entered the tournament with a mixed but generally strong run in 2025, including victories in World Cup Qualifiers and friendlies. Key attacking talents like Vinícius Júnior and Rodrygo Goes are expected to lead the charge for the five-time world champions.

items.headline: Mbappé's Knee Injury Raises France Concerns
items.body: France captain Kylian Mbappé has been managing a left knee sprain and a semitendinosus muscle injury, which caused him to miss several Real Madrid matches in early 2026. While he has returned to play, his fitness remains a significant concern for Les Bleus as the tournament progresses.

items.headline: Impact of Substitutes and Counter-Pressing Noted
items.body: Early observations from the tournament, consistent with trends seen in the FIFA U-20 World Cup 2025, highlight the increasing influence of substitutes and aggressive counter-pressing. Tactical flexibility and the ability of goalkeepers to act as playmakers are also becoming defining features of elite international football.
